close_reason: 6 sites swept across 5 sibling crates. Workspace lib clippy clean, 2792 tests pass. Pre-existing clippy::needless_borrows_for_generic_args in metadata-types tests is separately tracked at JMAP-79qy.
description:
Split from JMAP-x2gd.89. Canonical mail-server (10 sites) and chat-server (14 sites) have been swept to the let-else / if-let-else idiom under clippy::single_match_else. The pedantic lint also fires in the other 6 sibling extension-server crates:

- jmap-calendars-server: 5 sites
- jmap-contacts-server: 4 sites
- jmap-filenode-server: 4 sites
- jmap-metadata-server: 4 sites
- jmap-sharing-server: 2 sites
- jmap-tasks-server: 5 sites

Total ~24 sites. Pattern is identical to what landed in mail-server and chat-server:
  match expr { Some(s) => ..., None => { ...continue/return... } }
→ let Some(s) = expr else { ...continue/return... };

This is workspace-canonical-template-propagation — mail-server is already converged so each sibling is independent of the others.

P3 because clippy::pedantic is not enabled workspace-wide; the lint does not break CI. Idiom polish only. Mechanical, ~30 minutes total.
title: single_match_else propagation: 6 remaining sibling extension-server crates (split from JMAP-x2gd.89)
